instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy cube SQL metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
SELECT MIN(fact_claims.claim_amount) AS min_claim_amount
FROM fact_claims

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy cube SQL metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
SELECT MAX(fact_web_sessions.session_duration) AS max_session_duration
FROM fact_web_sessions

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy conditional metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Repeat Customers
Expression: COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) WHERE order_count > 1
output:
Repeat Customers = 
CALCULATE(
    DISTINCTCOUNT(fact_sales[customer_id]),
    FILTER(fact_sales, fact_sales[order_count] > 1)
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy cube SQL metric into a Power BI DAX measure.

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy time-intelligence metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Prior Quarter Claims
Expression: SUM(claim_amount) shifted back 1 quarter based on claim_date
output:
Prior Quarter Claims = 
CALCULATE(
    SUM(fact_claims[claim_amount]),
    DATEADD(DIM_DATE[date], -1, QUARTER)
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy calculated metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Lead Conversion Rate
Expression: COUNT(DISTINCT converted_lead_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy cube SQL metric with a filter condition into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id)
FROM fact_leads
WHERE lead_source NOT IN ('Referral', 'Direct')
output:
Non-Referral Leads = 
CALCULATE(
    DISTINCTCOUNT(fact_leads[lead_id]),
    NOT(fact_leads[lead_source] IN {"Referral", "Direct"})
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy cube SQL metric with a filter condition into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:

FROM fact_sales

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy calculated metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Avg Claim Processing Days
Expression: SUM(processing_days) / COUNT(DISTINCT claim_id)
output:
Avg Claim Processing Days = 
DIVIDE(
    SUM(fact_claims[processing_days]),
    DISTINCTCOUNT(fact_claims[claim_id])
)

instruction: Convert this MicroStrategy time-intelligence metric into a Power BI DAX measure.
input:
Metric: Ticket Volume Prior Year
Expression: COUNT(ticket_id) same period last year based on created_date
output:
Ticket Volume Prior Year = 
CALCULATE(
    COUNT(fact_support_tickets[ticket_id]),
    SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(DIM_DATE[date])
)
